title: Two staff can take a receipt for the same bill at the same time – the bill is collected twice
steps:
1. Arun (PC 1) and Divya (PC 2) open Receipts → New receipt for Indira G.
2. Both tick the same due bill (SBI MF Flexi Cap SIP · FOLIO-2202733, Nov 2026), Cash, notes = ₹2,000.
3. Both press Save receipt at the same moment.
expected: Only one receipt is saved; the second gets 'this bill is already paid' and nothing is recorded.
actual: Two receipts are saved for the same bill (e.g. AA-01 and AA-02, ₹2,000 each, for the Nov 2026 SIP instalment); both post to the Day Book, so the cash is counted twice. Race condition: reproduced in the full run and in 2 of 3 repeated attempts (AA-05 / AA-06 the second time).
fix: Second receipt for the same bill is refused ('the bill you ticked was just paid by someone else'); CONC-02 passes.

title: Editing the same customer on two PCs: the later save silently overwrites the earlier one
steps:
1. Admin and Arun open the same customer (Hari Prasad) → Edit details.
2. Admin sets Email = first.save@example.com → Save changes → Yes, save.
3. Arun (form opened before step 2) changes only Address → Save changes → Yes, save.
expected: Arun is warned that the record changed (or only his changed field is saved); Admin's email is kept.
actual: Arun's stale form is saved whole: the email Admin just entered is wiped (email = empty), with no warning. Reproduced 3 times once the test waits for the second save (an earlier pass was a test timing gap).
fix: Stale 'Edit details' save is refused ('This customer was just changed by …'); CONC-01 passes.

title: Customer list takes ~18 s with 2,000 customers
steps:
1. Load 2,000 customers / 10,000 policies (qa/specs/volume.spec.ts).
2. Open Partners / Customers (second load, route already compiled).
actual: 16.4–19.2 s over four runs. The list renders every customer (no paging). Measured on the dev server – confirm on a production build, but the gap is far beyond dev-mode overhead.
status: Improved – not yet under 3 s on the dev server
fix: List pages 50 at a time: 16–19 s → 4.4 s. Re-measure on a production build.

title: Renewals, dashboard and customer search exceed 3 s at volume
steps: With 2,000 customers / 10,000 policies: open /renewals (next 30 days), /dashboard, /customers?q=Vol Customer 19 (second load each).
actual: Renewals 5.4–8.7 s, dashboard 4.3–6.4 s, search 3.4–6.1 s over the runs (dev server). Receipts (0.9–2.3 s) and the customers Excel (1.2–3.3 s) are within or near the target. Re-measure on a production build.
status: Improved – not yet under 3 s on the dev server
fix: Renewals 5.4–8.7 s → 3.8 s (paged, counted in SQL); dashboard now passes; customer search still 7 s (text search over 10,000 policies). Needs an index or a production-build measurement.

title: Core money and sales actions are not in the change log
steps: Run journey J1 (lead → quotation → proposal → issue policy → receipt), then open Settings → Change log or query AuditLog.
expected: Each record created (lead, quotation, proposal, policy, receipt) has a change-log entry with who and when.
actual: No AuditLog rows for any of them. receipts/actions.ts and expenses/actions.ts make no audit() calls; creating a lead and issuing a policy are not logged either (only settings, tickets, consent etc. are).
fix: Leads, quotations, proposals, policies, receipts/payments and expenses are logged; INT-03 passes.

title: User references are not foreign keys in the database
steps: Query information_schema for FK constraints on Customer.ownerId, Lead.ownerId, Policy.ownerId, Receipt.createdById, Ticket.raisedById, AuditLog.userId, Expense.createdById.
expected: Each references User with a foreign key (or is documented as intentionally soft).
actual: None of them has an FK; only the app keeps them consistent (no orphans found today – INT-01 passes).
fix: Foreign keys to User added (migration 20261113150000_user_foreign_keys), applied to the dev database; INT-06 passes.

title: An Aadhaar number starting with 0 or 1 is accepted
steps: Customer → Add Aadhaar / PAN → tick consent → Aadhaar 012345678901 → Save.
expected: Refused – UIDAI numbers never start with 0 or 1 (and carry a Verhoeff check digit).
fix: Aadhaar must start with 2–9; VAL-04 passes.

title: Renewals View dropdown has no 'Custom dates' option
expected: Today, This week, This month, Next 30 days, Next 3 months, Last month, Custom dates (spec #19).
actual: 'Custom dates' is missing (From / To boxes are always shown instead) and there is an extra 'Default' option.
fix: 'Custom dates' added to the View dropdown; REN-01 passes.

title: Form fields without labels; duplicate element ids in the New lead dialog
steps: Inspect Raise ticket, Add expense and the New lead dialog with a screen reader / accessibility tree.
expected: Every field has an accessible name.
actual: Raise ticket: title, screen, type, priority, details unlabeled. Add expense: description, amount, vendor, bill no., paid by, mode, from account, notes unlabeled. New lead: 'Business type' and 'Lead status' reuse the page filters' ids, so their labels point at the filters.
fix: Labels tied to fields; New lead filter ids renamed; A11Y-01 passes.

title: Expenses help text still says the bill number is required
steps: Open Expenses → read the note under Add expense.
expected: Text says the bill number is optional (unique per vendor when entered) – spec #42.
actual: 'Bill number is required and unique per vendor' (saving without it works).
fix: Help text now says the bill number is optional; EXP-05 passes.
